sources.title: Meta SAM 3D - Turn Any Image into 3D
sources.snippet: Meta SAM 3D turns any image into a 3D object or human mesh using the Segment Anything ecosystem. Learn how SAM 3D Objects and SAM 3D Body reconstruct realistic geometry and textures for AR, VR, gaming, and research.

sources.title: SAM 3D - Turn Any Image into 3D Objects & Scenes
sources.snippet: Explore SAM 3D to reconstruct 3D objects, people and scenes from a single image. Build 3D assets faster with SAM 3D Objects and SAM 3D Body.
